risk_addressed: Packet readiness and response-disposition readiness are not enough; the operator needs one hash-bound handoff that lines up human authority, private vault roots, exact message bytes, and disposition rules before any external action.

operator_sequence.name: read-current-head
operator_sequence.required_output: operator confirms current START_HERE/README are rev0268 and no-send

operator_sequence.name: choose-branch
operator_sequence.required_output: private signed human branch decision: no-send, reviewer-first Eleos, two-step, AIID route-fit, retarget, or defer

operator_sequence.name: publish-authority-shell-if-authorized
operator_sequence.required_output: public hash-only shell with branch, timestamp, signer role, and signature/storage hash; no raw signature in release tree

operator_sequence.name: select-private-roots
operator_sequence.required_output: private roots outside-release directories for sent copy, transport proof, raw inbound, legal/conflict notes, and sealed evidence schedule

operator_sequence.name: send-time-route-and-hash-recheck
operator_sequence.required_output: fresh locator check plus recomputed packet/body/eml hashes immediately before send

operator_sequence.name: capture-sent-copy-and-transport
operator_sequence.required_output: raw sent copy and Message-ID/SMTP/DSN/bounce or failed-send proof in private root

operator_sequence.name: classify-first-outcome
operator_sequence.required_output: classification under reviewer-response-disposition playbook before public narration

operator_sequence.name: handle-failed-route
operator_sequence.required_output: failed-gate public summary for decline, referral, auto-ack, delivery-only, silence, failed-send, or private-data request

operator_sequence.name: scope-preservation-schedule
operator_sequence.required_output: sealed evidence classes requested, refused, unsafe, withheld, or deferred

operator_sequence.name: record-reviewer-appointment-or-nonappointment
operator_sequence.required_output: appointment terms, conflict/funding disclosure, or nonappointment failed-gate shell

private_vault_placeholders.public_release_tree_root_policy: raw private evidence must remain outside this ZIP and outside the public release tree

go_no_go_matrix.condition: reviewer-first signed but private roots absent
private roots ready but locator/hash stale
reviewer-first signed + roots ready + hashes fresh + no attachments
go_no_go_matrix.reason: permits only the hash-bound reviewer-first inquiry, not stage-two payloads or repeated contact

next_non_doctrine_action: A human must either sign a branch/no-send/defer record or explicitly stop the first external artifact attempt; no further doctrine or registry work can satisfy A1.
public_summary: rev0268 gives the operator a hash-bound authority/vault handoff dry-run. It still records no authority, no private root, no send, no contact, no response, and no live-floor effect.
